note: Work that WP0/WP1 left for apps/web (WP9, WP10). Both numbers must reach 0 before cutover.

wp9.spec: NOT in spec 5.8; required by decisions.md (Greek dropped)
wp9.what: Add permanent redirects /el/(docs|learn|developers/cookbook|developers/bootcamp)/:path* and their .md twins -> /<same path without /el>, plus exact /el/docs, /el/learn, /el/developers, /el/developers/cookbook and /el/developers/bootcamp. 566 Greek URLs depend on this: 468 docs, 52 cookbook, 33 bootcamp, 11 learn pages, /el/learn and /el/developers. Put the rule before withLocaleRedirects output, or drop el from its locale pattern, so that /el/docs/<R8 path> does not chain through /el/docs/<new path>. Every Greek row in move-map.csv already records its target in the redirect column.
wp9.status: done (WP9-edge): one regex redirect placed first in apps/web redirects covers /el/docs, /el/learn, /el/developers and /el/developers/{cookbook,bootcamp,guides,learn} plus .md twins and subpaths. Greek URLs of moved pages take two hops (/el/docs/old -> /docs/old -> /docs/new) to keep the route count under Next's 1,000 warning.

wp9.status: done (WP9-edge): handleDocsRequest in apps/web/src/middleware.ts (one 308; mixed-case .md twins included).

wp9.status: done (WP9-edge): Mintlify serves .md/Accept; PostHog docs_markdown_requested ported to apps/web middleware (src/lib/docs-edge/markdown-analytics.ts).
